Level 13 Bastion Facility

Prerequisite: None
Space: Roomy
Hirelings: 1
Order: Research

A place to drink and socialize: a bar, a coffee shop, or a tea room, with a colorful name such as the Rusty Flagon or the Dragon's Loft. The hireling, its bartender, keeps a network of spies scattered through nearby communities, who often frequent the Pub incognito.

Research: Information Gathering. For the next 7 days, the bartender's spies learn of all important events within 10 miles of your Bastion. During that time, they can reveal the location of any creature familiar to you within 50 miles, unless it is hidden by magic or somewhere the DM deems beyond their reach; if they find it, they also learn where it has been for the previous 7 days.

Pub Special. The Pub has one magical beverage on tap, chosen below; you can switch it at the start of a Bastion turn, and your DM may create others. A pint loses its magic 24 hours after it is poured.

  • Bigby's Burden: the enlarge effect of Enlarge/Reduce for 24 hours (no saving throw).
  • Kiss of the Spider Queen: the effect of Spider Climb for 24 hours.
  • Moonlight Serenade: Darkvision 60 feet for 24 hours, or +60 feet if you already have it.
  • Positive Reinforcement: Resistance to Necrotic damage for 24 hours.
  • Sterner Stuff: for 24 hours, you automatically succeed on saves to avoid or end the Frightened condition.

Enlarging the Facility. For 2,000 GP, your Pub becomes Vast: it can have two magical beverages on tap at once and gains three more hirelings (servers), for a total of four.
